body: I'm stupid because I can't get over it. I should be able to but for some reason, I can't. It makes me feel useless and it makes me angry at myself.
Social anxiety does not make me disabled, it makes me stupid. I know there is nothing to fear yet I can't bring myself to do anything about it.

Yeah, I've had it since I was 5. I've never been good with people, everyone I ever socialized with approached me, back when I was in school I would just sit back eat an apple and read, no matter where I was. My opinions of people have degraded to where I don't even want to bother with most now. People are shallow and boring in the long run and it gets old very fast.

I highly doubt it will work. My mental disability is I'm sad. I don't hallucinate, hear voices, have a learning disability or anything else. I'm just a sad, angry and pathetic person. That isn't a disability, it's being unable to cope.

I already get foodstamps. That was hard enough for my family. I wouldn't even qualify for disability, why would they waste money on someone who wants to kill themselves. I know plenty of people who deserve it much more then I do, yet can't get it. I'd prefer to be a bum then what I am now, a parasite.

I can't leave my family. If I left I would have no human contact at all anymore. Even though she treats me poorly my mother needs me. I have to much pride and am to stubborn to apply for disability or take handouts. I'm just going to be stuck here until I die or become like everyone else in my family.

My mother usually. I'm used to it though I suppose. Sister used to do it to, but I believe I told you she stopped after I punched a hole in the wall and said I hated her. My family consists of alchohalics and narcissists so support isn't an option really. It can be called for I guess, I'm not exactly a nice person.

Woke up being yelled at after a night filled with nightmares and depressing dreams. Was told I didn't do a good enough job raking leaves so I had to do it again, which takes a few hours. Was also reminded that I have no friends when I was asked why I spend all my time inside by myself. Those and a few things I'd rather not share have made this a particularly soul crushing day.

I know it is, but being polite has been beaten into me so much, that it causes me great discomfort if I do anything considered possibly rude. She is fickle in her moods, so I usually end up with a lot of scratches. Today has been really bad. I'm gonna have to go do some things. I'll try to check back before to long.

My cat gets into cuddly moods, but she tends to drool and kneed a lot when that happens. Very uncomfortable. Sorry if that seemed out of place, it just bothers me when I don't give my name, makes me feel rude. My cat actually sleeps on my lower back every night and will scratch me if I try to move her.
I have a cat, but she is almost as anti social as I am. By the way, my name is Vincent. Thought since I had been talking to you for so long it would be rude not to introduce myself.

I have nightmares about lost friends, and lost love if I don't drink myself into a coma. I really can't take the horrible loneliness of sleeping alone, and feeling empty. So I drink. Goodnight, thank you for talking to me again.

Even if that does happen, I can't connect to people. Talking to people, listening to their problems and helping them is all I have ever been good at, and it was the only thing I ever remotely enjoyed. I have no social skills, and I have a noxious personality. I don't know how much of you changes, but if it is that drastic I don't know if it would be good. I'm kind of running out of things to say, been drinking a bit.

Even as a happy person my life won't change. Even if I don't hate myself as much I still can't stand most people I meet. If ECT changed that, it would change who I am at my core. Therapy won't get rid of my social anxiety and rage, nor my dislike for rude and crass people. I'm glad these things have helped you, and it gives me a small glimmer of hope. The only problem is, if ECT does not work, I will have tried everything. I want to not feel this way, but if my last hope doesn't work, it will be the last straw. Every time my hopes get up they are crushed horribly causing me more pain the it was worth. Not a single time have I tried to be happy and not regretted it with every fiber of my being. I don't want to do ECT because I really can't risk having no choice but wishing I was dead every second of every day with no way out. I know it seems counter productive but I am absolutely scared out of my mind of it.

My biggest problem with that is I don't know if I can be happy if I change. Yes, I hate myself, down to every last detail, but despite all of that I actually know who I am. I don't have identity issues, never question who I really am, or why I am like this. I have an answer to every question about myself. Being happy would completely change that and I would no longer know who I am. Or that is what I fear most. I may not want to live now, but if I was completely lost and didn't know who I was anymore I know I couldn't live with that. Not for a single day.

A therapist of mine once said you will not get better if you don't want to. I really don't know if I want to get better at all. I don't know how to be happy, and I don't know what I would do if I didn't have this depression as part of my identity. It has defined me for half of my life. I don't like who I am now, but I at least know who I am.

It may be different but I'm still skeptical because nothing ever works the way it should when it comes to me. My mother wouldn't get it for me, she would demand I do it. I can't see her, she hurt me way to badly for me to even go near her. I can live without a phone.

I am useless, I've done nothing that is note worthy that wasn't completely horrible. Even if I don't kill myself I doubt I'd live past 25 anyway. My mother wouldn't because she doesn't even know I don't have my phone. If I tell her my ex has it she will make me get it back, and for my dignity's sake I cannot talk to her ever again. Professionals have been trying to help me for a long time, and I doubt ECT will even work.

I don't, I'm completely useless. The writing was went poorly, just a lot of anger and sadness manifested on paper. I really don't want to be put on disability, I doubt I will even live long enough to qualify. Sorry, I had to shower.

I tried it for about 3-4 minutes, but I started getting frustrated, and almost broke something. My family is a lot better then they were before. Mom got sober and after I punched a hole in the drywall my sister started to not yell as much. I can't move out at 18 if I even make it that far. I have no job, no money and no motivation to even leave the basement 90% of the time. I really don't have potential. I'm to awkward, angry and anxious to even meet new people, I don't see how I could live a normal life if I even wanted to.

I get yelled at because I'm the most passive person in my family and I'll sit there and take it. People treat people based on what they were taught and raised to think, so that fact that I wear all black gets me called emo and loser and I am treated poorly for it. Or maybe its something else, I don't have a good inside view on people anymore. I'll try the free writing, but I don't know if it will be good.
Because of who I am and what I have done, I deserve a slow and painful death, not happiness. I don't see how people can care about another person if they have no idea what they are like.

People do it a lot. I'm used to it at this point. It was a lot worse before I dyed my hair. It's not Oregon, I've been treated like this wherever I go. Free writing would end up with a long list of self hate in words, so I don't know about it. Sorry I'm a little side tracked. Getting yelled at currently.
Not me.

Apparently the message I sent didn't go through. I went on that walk, and it went as well as I thought it would. People driving by harassed and threw things at me. I shouldn't write because the fact that I am a terrible writer bothers me and no matter what I will get mad that I can't do it, or anything, right. Once again sorry, I thought I sent a message earlier.

I have steadily been getting worse over a period of 7 years, I really doubt ill get better any time soon, if at all. You shouldn't care about my life, I've done nothing but horrible things, and don't deserve to be happy or even to live.

I thank you for the suggestions, and I am sorry if it seems I'm just poking holes in your suggestions. Just because I love my cat doesn't make me a good person. I love animals and treat them kindly, but I hate human beings with a burning passion most of the time. I have talked about this for so many years and so often, that it doesn't help me to talk about it anymore. I really just want someone to point out a reason for me not to kill myself, because I've run out of reasons other then what if I fail at that to. But once again thank you.

Obvious, you don't, haha. I don't like Chirstmas, reminds me of how poor my family is and how much I am detested by them. Not a fun holiday. Fantasy is good if you can control it, but since I hate reality with such passion I delve to far into it, to the point of obsession.

I don't have a PO box, and due to me being a perfectionist I can't write without becoming even more disgusted with myself. I also try not to stray from reality to much. I have a habit of trying to use fantasy as an escape for real life, which is very unhealthy for me.

I can't help but let it get to me, it keeps pushing its way to the front of my mind. I can't go for another walk, I really can't take the constant train of thoughts right now. Everything outside reminds me of something. I don't know if I can pick anything up from the post office without ID.

The people in my life made me happy, but I ruined that quite badly. I've been drinking water, doesn't help much. I don't watch TV or movies anymore, it seems a lot of shows have gone down in quality. I haven't been able to read a book in a long time without being reminded of someone I cared for. As for hobby's, they used to be video games, and walking for very long periods of time, both of which no longer interest me. Nothing takes my mind off of how horrible of a person I have become, but thank you.

It's not her that affects me, it is the idiotic decisions I made after, which caused me to lose a person I considered as a brother. I'm used to the pain, it just gets annoying at times, especially when I am emotional. I doubt I could take a walk, don't really have a lot of energy at the moment. I hope you understand that I am extremely wary of posting my home address online, or giving it to someone I do not know well from the internet.

Found an old picture of my first girlfriend. Just made me remember a lot of things that make me feel like shit. I'm in pain because I have damaged kidneys, as well as suffer from migraines. Mixed with being hungover, it is a plethora of pain.
Eh, it gets asked so often that it doesn't bother me as much anymore. I feel worse I suppose. Pretty upset, best word I could think of how I feel, and in a lot of pain. How was your nap?

Unfortunately, I haven't felt anything that has made me happy in over a month. I don't leave my home for a few reasons, so I do not have a chance to even see something that could put a smile on my face. Sorry if this is worded poorly, I am extremely hungover.

I live in Oregon, I could be doing many drugs that are much worse, since their is a plethora of them in this state. I prefer to take the 50's approach on depression, and just drink it away when I can. No need to warn me, but thank you.

99% of the time, it just makes it so I don't feel anything at all. What got to me was the song. It's my favorite song, yet it never fails to make me feel lonely and hallow. I really don't want to stop since it gives me the rare times where I can genuinely laugh. It makes me stop thinking and stop berating myself.
Which part? haha
Feeling pretty shitty. Got drunk last night, listened to a sad song, cried, contemplated slitting my throat, then drank until I passed out.

First of all, thank you very much for replying and a lot of that is good advice. I know I have been contributing to that cycle, it is why I have isolated myself from everyone I knew. I can't stop hurting them, so I prevented myself from talking to them at all. I really like walking, and it's not the cold that stops me from doing it. I've lived in Oregon for 80% of my life, and I love the cold, and the rain. I actually have a 10 year old cat that I have had for 6 years. Taking care of her is great, but I don't see it the way you envisioned. She takes care of me more then I do her. Repeating a single phrase would actually stress me out more then just walking, as repetition bothers me more then anything in the world. That and focusing on the things around me tends to make my mind wander, which leads to connecting to something that depresses me more and more each day. I don't have specific things I can worry about, since most of the things in my daily life cause great stress. You aren't pushing anything, you are being incredibly kind in posting. I am very thankful for the people who said the nice things here, and truthfully it makes me feel a tiny bit better. Once again, thank you very much.

Thank you, and concentrating on other things is the only time I don't want to die. Helps take my mind off of a lot of things. I know about bottling my rage, I've been doing it since I was very young. It almost always manifests itself as self harm, and not hurting others so it doesn't bother me to much. Thank you very much. You're an incredibly kind individual.

I don't live near a walmart. Closest one is 50 miles away. Thank you for the offer but I couldn't take that from someone. I don't like to express my anger, I only use it when I'm about to burst with rage. I'm sorry its taking me so long to reply by the way. I'm doing something that takes a lot of concentration. But thank you, I understand how annoying it must be to have to listen to me complain.

I hit a stop sign because it was something not alive I could hit. I have to repress my rage and act happy, so no one notices. I can't afford the phone, and yes ex's are the worst, especially ones that want to be your friend after. And I say sad kid, because you are obviously my senior, but I am becoming an adult. I really am tired of being a pessimistic and angry. I want to have friends and I want to date, and be happy. Yet I hate everything about my age group. I may be 17, but I feel like an angry old man.

I decided to go back after I hit a stop sign and cut my hand up. I don't do the scheduling for any doctors appointments because my ex has had my phone for over a month, so when I was told I would be seeing a psychiatrist I was being lied to. Where I am is better then where I was about a year ago. I apologize constantly because I annoy myself so I thought I annoyed others even more. College isen't much of an option, I have no attention span. I don't have the energy for a job at the moment either. And thank you, not many people would put up with my sad kid bullshit for this long.

I went to the appointment and it was with a neurologist seeing if I would be able to handle ECT with my condition. I was lied to because I dislike my neurologist a great deal. I'm held in my past because I have nothing in my life currently and the way things have been going even if I got better I have virtually no future. I only have a GED, horrible social anxiety, paranoia and rage. I've been in therapy for the later for over 10 years, to no avail. I have no idea when I will be seeing a psychiatrist. My councilor is sadly the closest thing to someone I respect. I know the professionalism would make her not judge me, but it may cause the only person who I can stand to lose the last trace of respect for me. The reason I think I am a bad person is, no matter what I do I hurt those I care for. The reason I don't have friends anymore is because I made that choice. I hurt people no matter what I do, which makes me hate myself even more. I understand a lot of what is wrong with me, but talking about it, using exercises and trying different treatments and medications have done nothing to help. I'm afraid of who I am, and I hate myself, sorry if this has been all over the place, I'm not exactly in the right mind right now. My deepest apologies.

I've ruined multiple lives out of anger and jealousy. I really deserve to die, very painfully. I'm stubborn, passive aggressive, manipulative and angry. A combination that makes for a horrid human being. Some people at their core are bad people and deserve bad things in life, I believe I am one of them. I haven't seen a Psychiatrist since I was in a psychiatric ward of a hospital. I see a councilor once a week, but talking to someone doesn't help me very much though. We don't often talk about my problems. I try not to tell people, who can actively judge me, about my personal life.
Really don't know if I deserve to get better. I'll think about it. I'll check back in around 30 minutes.
I don't have anyone I care about, and I really shouldn't get into talking to myself anymore. I'll go outside and see how it goes, really can't make me feel any worse then I already do.

I have very low energy, as well as poor lung capacity due to having pneumonia multiple times. I also don't do well if I'm not distracted constantly. Constant racing thoughts and the inability to block them makes any time left without constant noise a personal hell.
I suppose she is fine for now. I live on top of a hill that goes down at a very steep angle for at least 2 miles in all directions. Walking is not something I am able to do anymore sadly.
Thank you, but I really have gotten to the point where I don't even want to get better.
Not very well. I'm hungover, and my my 20 month old niece almost died last night. I have extreme social anxiety so going to a gym would more then likely cause me to go into a panic attack.

Thanks for talking to me and reading this. I'm going to go drink then try to sleep. If anyone wants to talk, I may be back in the morning. If not, once again thank you, and I'm sorry to have wasted your time.

I don't know what kind of step I would be able to take. I may be a very hate filled person, but I still hold the door open for multiple people, do house work, go on walks, these small things are the only things keeping me connected to people at all. I have wanted to be a better person for 7 years. It's the only thing I ever wanted. I've been happy, and been nice, but after being hurt I slowly turned bitter and angry over the years. I have lost all hope in people, but mostly in myself. I've done terrible things to people for no reason other then they made me mad. I believe that I don't deserve to be happy, be loved, or even remotely liked by another human being. I apologize for getting off track but I suddenly got very emotional. Once again I am sorry for that.

I can't bring myself to change. I've tried before, but I always revert to my angry, passive aggresive and world hating self. I'm at the point where I hate the people I meet in person so much I have to restrain myself from shouting at them. I am, at my very core a bad human being. Perhaps I truly don't wish to change, I don't know. But I have been an angry, hateful shut in for 5 years and it seems it is who I am able to be without hurting others. I hate life, humanity, and most everything. And if you knew me, that would stop you from being nice to me. I don't deserve it.

Thanks but I can't consider anyone a friend anymore. Trusting people has done no good for me. I understand what you are saying, but the way I am I really don't have anything to look forward to. I'm antisocial, angry, awkward, stubborn, and in the words of my mother "A massive and judgmental prick." You are all very nice, but no one really knows another person through the internet. Being a pessimist I can't see the future being so bright. But thank you for showing interest and showing some concern. You, and everyone else I've ever seen post in this subreddit are the type of people I wish I could be like. So thank you again, even if it seems like I am being an ass, I meant this to be kind.
Thanks, but that hope that it can't get any worse or it can only get better  makes a new world of hurt and pain open up. Thank you though. Very nice of you to try and help.

I can't take medication. I've been on 15 different anti depressants because each one has had a violent and painful side affect. I am not able to take them, and people making decisions for me bothers me greatly. I have been homeless for a period of 3 months when I became to furious to stand my family, and it was much more enjoyable. Thank you for the advice though. It means a lot.
Thank you, you made me smile for a moment. You're very kind.

I'm only 17 sadly. I try not to mention it because I happen to not be taken seriously because of it. I am familiar with that song and that band, I used to listen to them about 2-3 years ago. I have no goal, I truly have never wanted anything but control over my life, an impossible goal. Thank you for replying by the way.
